    aes(
      x = .data$positive_p10_lx,
      xend = .data$positive_p90_lx,
      yend = factor(.data$placement, levels = c("Chest", "Near-eye"))
    ),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "grey45"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = .data$positive_p25_lx,
      xend = .data$positive_p75_lx,
      yend = factor(.data$placement, levels = c("Chest", "Near-eye"))
    ),
    linewidth = 5,
    lineend = "round",
    colour = "grey70"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = .data$positive_median_lx, colour = .data$placement),
    size = 4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = .data$positive_p99_lx, colour = .data$placement),
    shape = 21,
    fill = "white",
    stroke = 1.1,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = placement_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = LightLogR::symlog_trans(base = 10, thr = 1, scale = 1),

    labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ",")

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
